title: 第12章 登门第13章 惊喜
slug: 肉身成圣从养生太极开始
content_zh:
第二次忍界大战，纲手的恋人加藤断阵亡，死前肾脏被打飞，就连纲手的医术都无法治愈，最终死在了纲手的面前，从此以后，纲手便患上了恐血症，并在第二次忍界大战结束后隐退。
此时的琅玕身上尽是斑斑血迹，脸上更是布满了疲惫，不过他的眼中却是泛着神采，看起来对自己的伤势丝毫不在意。
有点像卡魔拉，不过五官并不是黑人的长相类型，但绝对够美艳。
夏侯武并没有撤去钻石飞剑，而是不断凝聚出新的钻石飞剑继续向陈彭二人攻击。
此时，洞内只剩下姜少阳和水墨两人，刚刚自来也离开，要进城内打探一些情报，约他们半夜在塔楼底下集合。
“娘去做几个你喜欢吃的菜。”
杨婷说完就离开别院准备饭菜去了。
根据云组织的管理，凡是得手之后，都要在尸体的坟墓前祭拜一阵子才能离开。
明镜恍然大悟，是了…虽然先皇是拓跋梁的堂兄，但是再往前一任的北晋王却是拓跋梁的亲爹。
会告诉他一些辛秘也不是什么奇怪的事情了。
那表情，那模样，带着浓浓的爱意，就像跨越了千年的爱人，顷刻之间要穿过时空来到索玉的身边抚慰她的心灵一般。
那种感情，还像是被刻在了三生石上一样，注定世世代代牵扯不断。
艾振霖这次没有穿军装，来参加这种场合只能说他是AI的幕后老板。
原主想要靠学习拼出一条路，那他如他所愿，这一生用学术走出一条路好了。
费良才脸上布满担忧，这种实力如果真的要对付希城，那么希城必败无疑。
坐在对面的苏程悦和慕清雅看着神情变化多端的周锦瑟，难掩笑意，看她该怎么逃脱。
“林若兰，你给我闭嘴，如果不是你，事情也不会发生到这种地步。”
白洁怒斥道。
谭琦作为雄峰的跟班，内劲中段的实力，不需要通报姓名，守门的自然认出他来。
秋风又探着头看了眼司绾的身后，随后脸上出现了疑惑的表情，但是话却卡在喉咙里没有问出。

他瞥了好几眼，几个埋头苦抄的体育生，似乎是感受到了方言的眼神，偏头望了过来。
也就是说，其他学院每一年会有一次升级考试，而墨白却不需要等那么久，他只要达要求，就可以考试。
“几条奴婢的贱命，还用得着劳烦大理寺？”
皇后一脸轻蔑的看着我。
content_en:
During the Second Ninja War, Tsunade's lover Kato Dan was killed in battle, and his kidneys were blown out before his death. Even Tsunade's medical skills could not cure him, and he finally died in front of Tsunade. From then on, Tsunade suffered from anemia and retired after the Second Ninja War.
At this time, Langgan's body was covered in blood, and his face was full of exhaustion, but his eyes were filled with energy, and he didn't seem to care at all about his injuries.
A bit like Gamora, but her facial features are not that of a black person, but she is definitely pretty enough.
Xia Houwu did not remove the diamond flying sword, but continued to condense new diamond flying swords and continued to attack Chen and Peng.
At this time, only Jiang Shaoyang and Shui Mo were left in the cave. Jiraiya had just left and wanted to go into the city to get some information. He asked them to gather under the tower in the middle of the night.
"Mom, make some dishes you like."
After Yang Ting finished speaking, she left the other courtyard to prepare meals.
According to the management of the Yun Organization, anyone who succeeds must worship in front of the corpse's grave for a while before leaving.
Ming Jing suddenly realized, yes... Although the previous emperor was Tuobal Liang's cousin, the previous King of the Northern Jin Dynasty was Tuobal Liang's biological father.
It's not strange to tell him some secrets.
That expression, that look, was filled with deep love, just like a lover who had spanned thousands of years and was about to travel through time and space to come to Suoyu's side to comfort her soul.
That kind of feeling seems to be engraved on the Sansheng Stone, destined to be involved for generations to come.
Ai Zhenlin was not wearing a military uniform this time. When he came to such an occasion, it could only be said that he was the boss behind AI.
If the original owner wants to make his way through study, then he can do what he wishes and use academics to make a way out of his life.
Fei Liangcai's face was full of worry. If this kind of strength really had to deal with Xicheng, Xicheng would definitely lose.
Su Chengyue and Mu Qingya, who were sitting opposite, couldn't hide their smiles as they watched Zhou Jinse's changing expressions, wondering how she could escape.
"Lin Ruolan, shut up. If it weren't for you, things wouldn't have happened like this."
Bai Jie yelled angrily.
As Xiongfeng's follower, Tan Qi was in the mid-level of internal strength, so he didn't need to tell his name. The gatekeeper would naturally recognize him.
Qiu Feng looked behind Si Wan again, and then a puzzled expression appeared on his face, but the words were stuck in his throat and he did not ask.
He glanced several times. Several sports students who were busy copying seemed to have sensed Fang Yan's eyes and turned their heads to look over.
In other words, other colleges have an promotion exam every year, but Mo Bai does not need to wait that long. He can take the exam as long as he meets the requirements.
"With the lives of several servants, why bother Dali Temple?"
The queen looked at me with contempt.
